Not sure which panels and nodes a DB needs? Open the DB, and look at the card Advice, best setup.
PatchLab counts the LK's, Veams, lines and universes, and works out the best setup from the devices in your Device Builder.
It chooses the cheapest combination of panels, and compares nodes with and without a splitter. It only uses devices you made yourself, never something you do not own.
When there are too few sockets, it adds loose spiders instead of a whole extra panel, and says so.
Open Block mode per LK. It advises twelve XLR for an LK with many ports, three Veams when an LK only carries Veams, and mixed in between.
Apply this advice, and PatchLab adds a rack made for this DB. Your own racks stay untouched, and you can apply again at any time.
The rack appears below, with every LK and Veam on its socket, and the colour of the node that feeds it.
